title: Electro-magnetic waves. Part 1. The Discovery and generation of electro-magnetic waves
brief_description: Part of the Advanced Science series. The discovery of the electro-magnetic spectrum from Newton’s observations on the composition of white light through the discovery of infra-red and ultra violet waves, to the more recent discoveries of radio and gamma waves. Demonstrates methods of generation, and modern uses of electro-magnetic radiation.
